answer: This ledger keeps its population fixed, like a lagoon with a hard shoreline. A fresh address may join only with a signed exit certificate proving some old account burned its keys: a pearl surrendered before a pearl is minted. Departure fees climb with tenure on a long terrace of tiers, so legacy weight cannot be cloned, only inherited. A farm that wants ten thousand seats must first kill ten thousand real ones, making every fake entry cost one true exit.
